text:
thomas: Quick sync — we need final acceptance criteria for the PRD covering Chat (completions), Embeddings, and Rerank. Can we groom today 3pm PT? Proposed agenda: launch gates, minimal acceptance criteria, fallback policy, rollout plan.

mira: 3pm works for me. I'll book a 30m slot. Add James from CS for customer constraints. :calendar:

james-cs: From customers — must support 1) bounded-cost mode (hard token cap) 2) embedding dimensional stability (no silent changes) 3) SLA: 99.9% availability, p95 latency goals matter more than p50.

alexm: For model variants: propose primary=redwood-m-7b-q4f, fallback=redwood-m-3b-q4f, and a degraded mode (prompt-truncation + cached responses) when capacity spikes.

sara: Edge-case: empty system+user messages + streaming = sometimes state machine gets stuck. Need an AC to reject empty prompts or return a deterministic no-op with 400.

eva: Also need rerank tie-breaker AC: stable sort by recency then score if score diff < 0.01.

thomas: Good calls. Draft acceptance checklist below — please comment inline in the doc before the meeting.

```
AC checklist:
- chat: p99 generation latency < 350ms for <= 256 tokens (hosted API, default model)
- chat: output token-streaming doesn't block client for > 100ms between chunks
- embeddings: vector dim stable across minor model updates; a version bump must come with a migration note
- rerank: deterministic fallback when scores tie; top-k selection stable under hashing seeds
- rollout: canary (1%), ramp to 25% at 24h, rollback automation if quality regressions > 2% on eval set
- cost gate: median cost per 1k tokens <= $0.70 (expected); flag if > 15% increase week-over-week
```

alexm: I'll wire up an eval harness to track regressed prompts + differenced embeddings.

eva: I'll add an integration test for empty+streaming and the rerank tie-breaker.

mira: I'll update the PRD draft and add the AC above as checkboxes. Meeting on calendar; invite sent. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/prs/1427 — "prd/acceptance/chat-embed-rerank" (thomas requested)

thomas: Thanks all. If nobody objects, I'll merge the AC into the PRD by EOD and assign owners for rollout checks. :rocket:

james-cs: No objections from CS. Will provide customer test cases before tomorrow EOD. :eyes:

sara: Quick note — add metric: per-route 95th percentile latency SLO and tokenization anomalies alert (high OOV %).

thomas: noted. See you at 3pm.
